new.evidence: "A shepherd is as dear to Him as a scholar" = "Ein Hirt ist Ihm so lieb, als ein Doktor" (p.140)

stored.evidence: "if someone were to carry stones into the sea" = "wenn einer Steine ins Meer trüge" (p.140)

defects.note: Renders རྟོག་པ as 'discernment' in 'explain the discernment of Great Bliss Vajrasattva', where it means the kalpa/ritual.

new.evidence: 'The phrase "without exception, leaving none behind" has already been explained' = མ་ལུས་ཤིང་ལུས་པ་མེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ནི་བཤད་ཟིན་ཏོ (p22)

defects.note: Makes 'the Great Bliss Vajrasattva of the Primordial Vajra' the one who gives. In the Tibetan, Vairocana gives the primordial vajra, the sign of accomplishment, into Vajrasattva's two hands.
Renders རྟོག་པ (kalpa/ritual-discernment) as 'practice'. It is also rendered loosely elsewhere.

stored.evidence: 'refers to the one held in the hand of the Blessed One Vairochana in the Great Mandala of the Vajra Realm' = རྡོ་རྗེ་དབྱིངས་ཀྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་ཆེན་པོར་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད་ཀྱི་ཕྱག་ན་གནས་པ (p22)

new.evidence: 'Two stars, or the mane of Leo and the hair clustered between the shoulder blades' = 'Duo sidera, seu iuba ♌ & crines inter spatulas conferti' (page 106, printed p. 51). Its added Arabic glosses (e.g. 'the Gap or Sneeze, Praesepe') are reasonable notes on the source terms, not invented page content. The same image caveat applies: p106.jpg actually shows printed p. 49.

stored.evidence: 'The Eye of Taurus..., a station of the Moon so named' = 'Oculus Tauri, statio ☽ sic dicta' (page 106, printed p. 51). Caveat: the image files look shifted by two printed pages. p105.jpg shows p. 48, p106.jpg shows p. 49 (Caput III) and p107.jpg shows p. 50. So I judged against the page 106 transcription; no scan of p. 51 was supplied.

defects.note: Marginal note 'Thetis pro filio supplicat' is rendered as 'Thetis supposes for her son' instead of 'supplicates for her son'.
The summary names Odysseus and his crew, but Odysseus is not mentioned on this page.
διογενὴς ('Zeus-born') is rendered as 'noble'.

new.evidence: "Then they dispersed to their shelters and ships" = αὐτοὶ δ’ ἐσκίδναντο κατὰ κλισίας τε νέας τε (p29)

stored.evidence: "When the sun went down and darkness came" = ἦμος δ’ ἠέλιος κατέδυ, καὶ ἐπὶ κνέφας ἦλθε (p29)

defects.note: Adds 'today' to 'here ... and tomorrow in the grave' (כאן ומחר בקבר)
Appends an editorial summary of the page's doctrine that is not part of the manuscript text. It is also cut off mid-sentence.

'ונתפס מי שיחשב' is rendered with an interpretive 'is mistaken' and the following clauses are restructured. Other passages are also smoothed into readings the garbled source does not clearly support, e.g. 'whose copies are evil perfections'.

new.evidence: 'tomorrow in the grave; and His loving-kindness to them has an end and a limit' = 'ומחר בקבר • וחסדו להם סוף וקוף' (page 61)

defects.note: 'וכעבור קצת' is rendered 'according to some' when it means 'after a little'
'וחי זהו' / 'וחי חי' is rendered word for word as 'and this, this' / 'the living, the living'. This misreads the oath formula ('by his life').
In 'more this will necessitate upon the part that is desired' and similar places, the word-for-word rendering garbles the syntax enough to obscure the meaning

stored.evidence: 'today and tomorrow in the grave' / 'here and tomorrow in the grave' = 'הם כאן ומחר בקבר' (page 61)

new.evidence: 'Let everyone take strength from his image whom his' = 'An seinem Bilde stärke sich jeder, den sein' (page 94)

defects.note: After the page-94 footnotes it adds the full text of the next page (p.71: 'profession obliges one to freely and boldly confess the truth… the truth avenges him early'), which is not on page 94.
'wo keine Widerlegung Statt fand' given as 'where no refutation took place'. The sense is 'where no refutation was possible or fitting'.

stored.evidence: 'Contempt for all their slanders is the least of the sacrifices' = 'Verachtung aller ihrer Verläumdungen ist noch das geringste Opfer' (page 95/p.71); 'He casts out demons through Beelzebub' = 'Er treibt die Dämonen aus durch Beelzebub' (page 94)

new.evidence: 'Three suburban villages obey the jurisdiction of Nijmegen ... Hees, Nederbosch, and Hatert' = 'Noviomagensium jurisdictioni parent tres pagi suburbicarii ... Hees, Nederbosch & Hatert' (page 41)

stored.evidence: 'neither are there in civil cases that do not exceed the value of 150 gold pieces' = 'neque in causis civilibus quæ pretium CL aureorum non excedunt' (page 41)

defects.note: τὰ τῇ βασιλίδι ἐντεταλμένα means orders given by the empress (dative of agent; Latin 'imperatricis mandata'), but it is rendered 'the commands given to the empress'.
'descending from there as from a base of operations on the head' garbles 'from there, as from a base, overrunning the head [citadel]', so the city image is unclear.

new.evidence: 'he imitated the Athenian Pisistratus and seized the acropolis of the Thessalonians' = τὸν Ἀθηναῖον μιμεῖται Πεισίστρατον καὶ τὴν Θεσσαλονικέων χειροῦται ἀκρόπολιν (p.167)

defects.note: τὰ τῇ βασιλίδι ἐντεταλμένα is rendered 'the commands given to the Empress' instead of orders given by the empress.
'overhanging the head of the city' adds to the Greek; the original just says ὁρμητηρίου τῆς κεφαλῆς κατατρέχων.

stored.evidence: 'some pious men, casting off all cowardice, took up the bodies' = φιλοθέων ἔνιοι, δειλίαν ἀποκρουσάμενοι πᾶσαν ... ἀνελόμενοι (p.167)

defects.note: The added note says bisextile and trisextile were 'aspects derived by Fludd from division by six'. This is speculative commentary that is not on the page.

new.evidence: 'Neither sympathy nor antipathy is situated in the opposition itself, but only greater powers of effectiveness' = 'Non est ergo in Oppositione sita neque Sympathia, neque antipathia, sed vires solum efficacitatis maiores' (p27)

defects.note: The translation breaks off mid-word at 'Unless, having dismissed the assoc'. It leaves out the rest of page 27, from 'Nisi missâ cælestium & sublunarium consociatione...' through the final paragraph 'Nam hæc antipathia... vires solum efficacitatis maiores'.
It adds a section heading, 'REBUTTAL TO ROBERT FLUDD', that is not printed on the page.

stored.evidence: 'the bells in the temples are by no means silent during the opposition of the Moon with malefic planets' = 'Campanæ inquis, in templis minime silent in oppositione Lunæ cum malevolis' (p27)

defects.note: Adds editorial notes giving Daodejing chapter numbers that are not on the page, and adds an unrelated keyword, 'Wu Shiyu'.
For 夷希微, it renders 微 (搏之不得曰微) as 'the formless' and the headword as 'Subtlest of Forms'. The gloss on 夷 and 微 is muddled.
The commentary 闔謂呼吸 is rendered as 'closing refers to breathing in'. 呼吸 means ordinary breathing out and in.

new.evidence: 'Opening and closing the heavenly gate, can you play the female role?' = 天門開闔能為雌 (p85)

defects.note: In 'strengthen their bones' (強其骨), the verb is left untranslated as '<unclear>丨</unclear> their bones'; the scan shows the passage plainly.
'govern and examine the Way of harmony' adds 'govern'. The source has only 丨丨丨察和之道, where the ditto marks stand for the preceding headword, not a verb meaning 'govern'.

stored.evidence: 'The Valley Spirit does not die; this is called the Mysterious Female' = 谷神不死是謂元牝 (p85)
